name: decim_attn
note: The one configuration the reshape ladder pointed at and did not contain. Corrected for the sweep's own confound (base had no normalization; decim/deep did), the ladder decomposes as: decimation alone +0.45 (8/10, p=0.16), stage-2 depth alone -1.74 (3/10, p=0.065), attention at 10 tokens +1.16 (7/10, p=0.23). Depth is the only step that costs, and attention does not repay it -- so deep_attn lands at 69.76, below plain base at 70.67. This arm removes the expensive step and keeps the two that pay: decimate to 74 tokens WITHOUT stage-2 depth, attention on. If the token-budget mechanism is what makes attention work, 74 tokens is already far inside the regime every published conv-transformer occupies (ATCNet 13, CTNet 15, MSVTNet 18, Conformer 61), and no depth penalty is incurred. Pre-registered: decim_attn > decim by roughly the +1.16 measured at 10 tokens, putting it near or above base at 70.67. Falsified if it lands at or below decim (70.33), which would mean attention needs the 10-token budget specifically rather than merely a non-redundant one.
